data.text: Luke, I learned to fish here with my family, and I want our village to keep earning from this lake—not just have one good month. Taking 15 each gets us an extra $5,000 now, but leaves only 25 tons we can sustainably share next month, instead of 50. That wipes out the gain if we share equally. I’ll choose 10 tons, and I’m asking everyone to agree to the same cap. Once catches are revealed, we can review the agreement together. If the stock falls below 100, our combined catch should be no more than half the starting stock so it can recover. John, will you join me—and Luke, would you reconsider?
